body:
# Enhancements

Disruption

Now, the Disruption module has a new icon to more easily distinguish it from other features and modules. 

# Fixes

### Accessibility

Now, users can select only specifications that are applicable to Accessibility.  In other words, users will no longer be able to select CMS Medicare Advantage specifications within Accessibility as they are not applicable.

### Assess Markets

Now in the PDF Market Leaders pages, the top 10 networks display instead of the top 9.

### Manage Users

In the past, various fields such as email and other account details are auto-filled with data from the last user created.  Now, these fields are not auto-filled.  

### Project Settings

Now on Project Settings > Specialty Mapping tab, when the user changes the Project Specialty Mapping Assignment and the user is currently in that project, the specialty mapping will update in the top right corner of the screen and in the Project Specialty Mapping Assignment.
shortDescription: This Network360 release includes security fixes, a new icon for the Disruption module and fixes in other features.
